assessment.title: Engagement profile
assessment.hint: 17 questions · concludes whether the entity is complex, non-complex or simple

questions.listed: Is the entity listed or does it make a public call for savings (APE)?
questions.publicInterest: Is it a public-interest or regulated entity (bank, microfinance, insurance, pension)?
questions.group: Does it prepare consolidated financial statements or is it a significant group component?
questions.jointAudit: Is this a joint audit (joint statutory auditors)?
questions.foreignOps: Are there foreign operations or significant foreign-currency transactions?
questions.complexFinancing: Is the financing complex (derivatives, hedging, structured debt, covenants)?
questions.complexRevenue: Is revenue recognition complex (long-term contracts, multiple streams, variable consideration)?
questions.estimates: Are there significant estimates or fair values (impairment, provisions, deferred tax)?
questions.controlsReliance: Will the audit rely on internal controls or is the control environment complex?
questions.complexIt: Is the IT environment complex or highly automated (integrated ERP, e-commerce)?
questions.multiLocation: Does the entity operate from multiple locations, branches or warehouses?
questions.largeSize: Does it exceed large-entity thresholds (revenue above 1 billion FCFA or over 100 staff)?
questions.firstAudit: Is this a first-year audit, or has the entity existed for less than two years?
questions.goingConcern: Is there going-concern pressure, significant litigation or a prior modified opinion?
questions.relatedParties: Are there extensive related-party or intra-group transactions?
questions.restructuring: Was there a major acquisition, disposal or restructuring during the period?
questions.litigation: Is the entity party to significant litigation, claims or regulatory proceedings?

errors.invalid-value: That value is not one of the options offered.

errors.requires-senior: Only a senior or above can sign as reviewer.

errors.review-conclusion-first: Review the section conclusion ("Reviewed (senior/manager)") before signing the paper as reviewer.

errors.tieout-unexplained: The tie-out shows differences — explain them in the tie-out procedure before answering "Yes".
errors.materiality-out-of-range: The percentage is outside the firm's range for this benchmark — give a justification for the deviation.
errors.materiality-basis-mismatch: The amount differs from the trial-balance base for this benchmark — give a justification for the deviation.
errors.not-preparer-clears: The preparer of this paper cannot clear a note raised against it — reply to it and let the reviewer clear it.
errors.requires-manager-or-author: Only the note's author or a manager who did not prepare the paper can clear it.
errors.rebut-partner-only: Only a partner can rebut the presumed revenue-fraud risk (ISA 240 ¶26).
errors.performance-justification-required: Tolerable error departs from the default share of materiality — give the justification for the percentage chosen.
errors.specific-above-te: A specific materiality must be below tolerable error (ISA 320 ¶10).
errors.significance-unjustified: Every significance decision that departs from the default needs its justification before P6.2 is signed off.
errors.no-portal-contact: This client has no portal contact, so no reminder can be sent — add a portal contact first.
errors.reclassify-reason-required: Planning has started: give the reason for changing the nature-of-entity conclusion.
errors.reclassify-too-late: The nature of the entity can no longer be reclassified once the file has left execution.
errors.itapp-strategy-missing: Every relevant IT application needs an IT strategy before S2.3 is signed off — decide the strategy of each application still at "— decide".
errors.nature-not-permitted: An analytics-led nature is not permitted for a significant risk: tests of details are required (ISA 330 ¶21).
errors.eqr-not-assignable: The engagement quality reviewer cannot be assigned engagement work (ISQM 2 ¶18-20).
